# Synthetic: a stalled reader. The second write finds the queue over
# the 64 KiB client budget and parks; draining completes it.
packet 1 7 0 1340 0 
expect reply 00000000 24 010000000000000002000000000000000300000000000000 0 -
packet 5 1 3 7 0 73746172740d0a
expect reply 00000000 7 - 0 -
expect vt 73746172740d0a
packet 5 1 3 16 0 7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a held=65537
packet 7 1 3 12 4 010000010400000000000000 held=65553
expect reply 00000000 0 03000000 0 -
drained held=65553
drained
expect complete 00000000 16 - 0 -
expect vt 7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a7a
hangup
expect close
expect eof
packet 7 1 3 12 4 010000010400000000000000
expect reply c0000001 0 - 0 -
